_comment: Curated model catalog for the Config tab's multi-model tier pickers. EDIT THIS to add/update models as providers ship them — it's just a lookup. Keys are matched by LONGEST NAME-PREFIX against whatever your endpoint's 'List models' returns, so 'gpt-4.1' also matches 'gpt-4.1-2025-04-14', while the longer 'gpt-4.1-mini' wins for 'gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14'. A model may appear in several buckets (e.g. gpt-4o is both chat and vision). Anything your endpoint lists that ISN'T here falls back to a name heuristic. Buckets: chat = main conversation/tool-calling; cheap = fast/background/scheduled; smart = hard reasoning; vision = can read images (required for the vision tier).
